Phil Wilson has distinguished himself in the world of jazz as a trombonist, arranger, and celebrated educator at the Berklee School of Music.
Phil was interviewed via Zoom on September 27, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very, very pleased to have Mr. Phil Wilson with me today, trombonist, jazz educator, composer, and arranger. Thanks for your time.
Oh it’s a pleasure to be here, Monk. Thank you for asking me.
